A single shared account-level throttle must prevent alternating source routes to bypass this cooldown. Reference [2026-10-16 additive Ledger](DECISION_LEDGER_2026_10_16_URL_PREVIEW.json). Do not silently weaken source-fetch SSRF defenses, expose user JWT/Claude BYOK secrets, or add required AI charges.
